text:
Alex P: Heads up — noticed p95 climb on /chat/gold last hour after the kernel-prefetch rollout. baseline was ~220ms, now ~320ms. Any obvious suspects?
Maya L: saw that too. KV hit rate dropped from 88% -> 75% around the same time. traces show more microbatches hitting cold KV.
Kevin T: did the batcher change microbatch size or queue window? We swapped kernel selection earlier but that shouldn't affect KV eviction directly.
Alex P: Kernel switchover was staged to perf-nn-v2 at 3739999000, but prefetch configs were tightened in the same release. suspect interplay between smaller queue window + tighter prefetch freshness.
Rachel S: attaching a quick profile I ran: perf-bot, can you post the top spans?
perf-bot: top spans (sample):
- fill_batches: 38%
- kv_lookup: 22%
- kernel_dispatch: 18%
- wait_queue: 12%
- serialize: 5%

Maya L: fill_batches spike suggests more small batches forming. if queue_window_ms dropped we may be cutting off batching and losing KV locality.
Kevin T: config snapshot from canary: 
```json
{"queue_window_ms": 9, "max_microbatch_tokens": 64, "kv_prefetch_ttl_ms": 400, "token_budget_per_route": {"gold": 150, "standard": 80}}
```
Alex P: previously queue_window_ms was 16 and kv_prefetch_ttl_ms was 800 on stable. so both changed.
Rachel S: proposed quick experiment: revert queue_window to 16 on canary for gold route only, keep kernel v2. measure p95 & kv hit rate for 15m. also bump token_budget for gold from 150 -> 220 to let batches accumulate slightly larger microbatches.
Maya L: agree. small change set so rollback is trivial. We should also add a route-tiered token budget allocator that considers recent kv_hit_rate to avoid underbudgeting during cold periods.
Kevin T: canary config to apply: 
```json
{"match_route": "^/chat/gold","overrides": {"queue_window_ms": 16, "token_budget_target": 220}}
```
Alex P: timeline: apply at 3740004380, measure p95 and kv_hit for 15m blocks, report back. if p95 improves by >30ms and kv_hit recovers by >8% we roll to prod.
Rachel S: note: watch kernel_dispatch latency — if microbatches grow, kernel scheduling could see slightly higher tail. keep an eye on tail tail.
perf-bot: canary applied at 3740004380, collecting metrics.
Maya L: quick thought — add a short-term metric: "effective_prefetch_window" = min(kv_prefetch_ttl_ms, queue_window_ms*avg_token_ms). helps us detect mismatch between prefetch TTL and batching times.
Alex P: good idea. if effective_prefetch_window < model_prefix_ms we get wasted prefetch. add alert if kv_hit_rate drop >7% and effective_prefetch_window decreases >20% in 5m.
Kevin T: after 10m look: p95 for /chat/gold moved from 318ms -> 272ms, kv_hit_rate 75% -> 84%. kernel_dispatch median unchanged. promising.
Rachel S: that's within expected. let's run 30m before wider rollout. prepare a canary-run note for eng-runtime channel with exact config diff and rollback command.
Alex P: thanks team. follow-ups: 1) implement route-aware token_budget autoscaler that incorporates kv_hit_rate, 2) add effective_prefetch_window metric + alert, 3) schedule a regression test: simulate cold KV and assert p95 under 350ms for gold.
Maya L: I'll own (1). Kevin please wire (2) to observability. Rachel will draft the canary note.
Kevin T: on it. ETA couple hours for dashboards.
Rachel S: drafting canary note now, will post when done. :thumbsup:
